mapper.sql: emp10_addr_book_id AS addr_book_id , emp10_contacter_nm AS contact_name , emp10_email_addr AS email_address , emp10_mobile_telno AS mobile_tel_no , emp10_office_telno AS office_tel_no , emp10_company_nm AS company_name , emp10_pos_nm AS pos_name , emp10_note AS note , emp10_public_yn AS public_yn , emp10_person_id AS person_id
mapper.select: SELECT , NULL AS person_name FROM emp10_addr_book WHERE emp10_person_id = #{personId} AND ( UPPER(emp10_contacter_nm) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) OR UPPER(emp10_email_addr) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) OR UPPER(emp10_company_nm) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ) AND COALESCE(emp10_public_yn, 'false') LIKE 'false' ORDER BY emp10_contacter_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc

SELECT , f_emp_kor_nm(emp10_person_id) AS person_name FROM emp10_addr_book INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp10_person_id = emp01_person_id WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND ( UPPER(emp10_contacter_nm) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) OR UPPER(emp10_email_addr) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) OR UPPER(emp10_company_nm) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) OR UPPER(emp10_note) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ) AND emp10_public_yn = 'true' ORDER BY emp10_contacter_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc

SELECT , f_emp_kor_nm(emp10_person_id) AS person_name FROM emp10_addr_book WHERE emp10_addr_book_id = #{addrBookId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_person_id = emp10_person_id AND emp01_company_id = #{companyId} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp10_addr_book (emp10_addr_book_id, emp10_contacter_nm, emp10_email_addr, emp10_mobile_telno, emp10_office_telno, emp10_company_nm, emp10_pos_nm, emp10_note, emp10_public_yn, emp10_person_id) VALUES (#{r.addrBookId}, #{r.contactName}, #{r.emailAddress}, #{r.mobileTelNo}, #{r.officeTelNo}, #{r.companyName}, #{r.posName}, #{r.note}, #{r.publicYn}, #{personId})
mapper.update: UPDATE emp10_addr_book SET emp10_contacter_nm = #{r.contactName}, emp10_email_addr = #{r.emailAddress}, emp10_mobile_telno = #{r.mobileTelNo}, emp10_office_telno = #{r.officeTelNo}, emp10_company_nm = #{r.companyName}, emp10_pos_nm = #{r.posName}, emp10_note = #{r.note} WHERE emp10_addr_book_id = #{r.addrBookId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_person_id = emp10_person_id AND emp01_company_id = #{companyId} )
